tvShow.name: My Life with the Walter Boys
tvShow.originalName: My Life with the Walter Boys
tvShow.overview: When a tragedy disrupts her life, a teen moves in with her guardian's big family in a small town and learns new lessons about love, hope and friendship.

episodes.name: Welcome to Colorado
episodes.overview: After a tragic loss, Jackie moves in with the Walters and tries to adjust to small-town life. But a new home and new high school bring new challenges.

episodes.name: Live a Little
episodes.overview: When the brothers make a bet involving a prank on Jackie, she turns to Katherine but learns that the boys have their own way of handling their issues.

episodes.name: The Cole Effect
episodes.overview: At the Homecoming Huddle, Alex and Jackie run the Walter family cider cart together with help from Cole, who struggles to accept life without football.

episodes.name: Nineteen
episodes.overview: On Lucy's birthday, Jackie decides to skip school and attend a lake house party with Cole, where the two play a high-stakes version of Truth or Dare.

episodes.name: Thanksgiving
episodes.overview: Jackie wants to avoid the first Thanksgiving without her family, but a surprise visitor lifts her mood and presents her with a difficult choice.

episodes.name: Baggage
episodes.overview: Before the big bonfire, Jackie learns about Cole and Alex's history with another girl. At the party, relationships new and old go up in flames.

episodes.name: Small Town Rumors
episodes.overview: As rumors fly about the Walter boys, Alex and Cole's sibling rivalry reaches its breaking point. Later, the family deals with an unsettling emergency.

episodes.name: Spinning Out
episodes.overview: When Katherine wins an award for her veterinarian work, the family jumps to support her — except Cole, who instead heads down a path of self-destruction.

episodes.name: Revolutions
episodes.overview: Jackie misses Alex's county fair rodeo for an important interview and tries to keep her distance from Cole after their hurtful exchange.

episodes.name: Happily Ever After
episodes.overview: With the Walter boys' help, Jackie diligently plans a picture-perfect ranch wedding. But no amount of checklists can prepare her for what happens next.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When a tragedy disrupts her life, a teen moves in with her guardian's big family in a small town and learns new lessons about love, hope and friendship.

episodes.name: Start Fresh
episodes.overview: Back from New York City, Jackie learns that picking up where she left off with the Walters won't be easy — especially with Alex and Cole.

episodes.name: My Life Without the Walter Boys
episodes.overview: Jackie channels her energy into keeping a tradition alive. Katherine and George are forced to loosen their reins — whether they want to or not.

episodes.name: Girls Just Wanna have Fundraisers
episodes.overview: In his new role, Cole struggles to separate leadership from friendship. Jackie and George discover that letting go of the past is harder than expected.

episodes.name: No-look Pass
episodes.overview: An impulsive brag sends Jackie and Grace on a club-hopping quest. The gridiron heats up as the Big Horns seek redemption against their archrivals.

episodes.name: A Night to Remember
episodes.overview: Paris comes to Silver Falls High at an enchanting fall formal. But not everyone will leave the dance with their dignity intact.

episodes.name: After the Dance
episodes.overview: After an incident at the ranch, the Walters reassess what's most important to them. Jackie delivers an emotional message to the junior class.

episodes.name: Saddle Up
episodes.overview: With no room for distraction, Alex kicks up dust to achieve his dream. Determined to start anew, Cole faces an uphill climb.

episodes.name: Gear Shifts
episodes.overview: A college fair sparks tension — and opportunity — at Silver Falls High. As horns lock over the ranch's future, Will gets caught in the middle.

episodes.name: Allhallowtide
episodes.overview: Couple trouble brews beneath the surface at Skylar's Halloween spooktacular, while a reminder of loss reawakens Jackie's bittersweet feelings.

episodes.name: Showdowns and Sparkles
episodes.overview: Jackie, Cole and Alex face tests of focus and courage in the runup to Silver Falls' annual festival. But it's their hearts that will be tested most.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Jackie returns to Silver Falls after a summer in New York, determined to make amends with Alex and set boundaries with Cole. Alex is focused on rodeo training, while Cole finds himself struggling to fill the void left by football. Jackie must navigate the complexities of the Walter family and her own identity, ultimately facing a crucial choice that could significantly impact her future in Colorado.

episodes.name: Homecoming
episodes.overview: In the wake of a medical emergency, Jackie and Katherine fight to keep the fractured Walters together as they reassess their lives and what matters most.

episodes.name: Split Focus
episodes.overview: Jackie struggles to keep up with school commitments as Cole hits a roadblock at the garage. Alex's fame opens the door to an exclusive event.

episodes.name: Fever Pitch
episodes.overview: A high-octane hobby sparks friction at home. While George hits a recovery milestone, Jackie scouts the perfect location for a project close to her heart.

episodes.name: Screeching Tires and True Love
episodes.overview: An unexpected visitor arrives for Jackie, sparking a mixed reaction from Cole. Kiley's well-intentioned gesture pushes Alex toward a rowdy crowd.

episodes.name: The Jackie and Cole Effect
episodes.overview: Cole discovers a bargain in a barn. A surprise reunion at the ranch reopens old wounds. Jackie throws a party for Grace that takes an eventful turn.

episodes.name: Wide Open Spaces
episodes.overview: With the rumor mill in full swing, tensions flare between Richard and Jackie over her future. Danny and Erin feel the strain of their shared secret.

episodes.name: Washout
episodes.overview: A troubling exchange with Wylder leaves Alex on edge. An awkward family dinner forces Kiley to face uncomfortable questions about her home life.

episodes.name: Everybody’s Fine
episodes.overview: Jackie's feverish attempt to regain control pushes her to the brink. Katherine urges Alex to join Cole on a treacherous climb.

episodes.name: Ghosts
episodes.overview: While renovating the teen annex, Jackie and her crew uncover a haunting secret frozen in time. George's absence looms over the family scavenger hunt.

episodes.name: The Beautiful and The Damned
episodes.overview: As a daunting setback threatens the opening of the community space, Jackie, Cole and Alex reconsider their futures — both romantically and beyond.
